items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Pete Fountain and Godfrey Hirsch and Dick Brown wrote the lyrics to it

ctx.x: Brown. I don't know that she's broke, but I don't think that she wants to lose any more money than she's losing. I remember when you had to have a reservation at the Edgewater. Is it the Edgewater? No, no, no, it's the name of the hotel, Brown's Hotel.
I don't know, I can't remember.
